laws.rule: In Brijuni National Park, visitors must keep to marked trails and the park's own transfers and tours; climbing on monuments, removing archaeological finds or fossils, feeding animals, camping, campfires and smoking outdoors (except on restaurant terraces) are banned, and swimming is only at marked bathing areas. Commercial photography or filming needs the park's permission, and park wardens may check tickets and ID.
